svg.title: RuVector. Give your agents memory. Explore RuVector.
svg.desc: Local semantic search, persistent memory, graph relationships and learning from explicit feedback. Open the RuVector repository. Rotating perspective-projected vector structures inspired by RuVector Explorer: spherical search lattice, layered graph, memory helix and feedback torus. Eight illustrative slides cover semantic search, relationships, persistent memory, feedback learning, local embeddings, memory lifecycle, optional sharing and a Rust native foundation.

g.text: Combine graph context with vector search.
Retrieve related information for your agents.
Bring useful knowledge into the next task.
Learning needs explicit feedback, not reads alone.
Use memory lifecycle controls as context evolves.
Turn text into semantic vectors locally.
Keep the default retrieval path close to your agents.
Extend local memory with optional sharing.
Hosted services introduce a separate data boundary.
Bring vector retrieval into agent workflows.
Explore the code, packages and getting started guide.
